_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate is 0-for-40 on ±2+ point moves and the analyst's own direction record is 18%—HOLD with conviction is the skilled call here; a directional UP claim requires seeing the breaker (funding > 0.015%, momentum clearing 65, liquidity ticking above 10) which has not fired yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split—both see the August 2024 bottom analog and structural accumulation, but the analyst hedges to low-conviction LONG while the narrative commits to a 0.76 confidence reversal story; the judge sides with the analyst's caution given the macro divergence and coil statistics.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with btc_momentum_30d clearing 65 and fed_liquidity ticking above 10
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $61,000 with exchange_netflow spiking above 60 and long_short_pct_30d dropping below 8
